 The Citizens will be the next big test for Aston Villa.
 Unai Emery looks forward to the visit of the table toppers. By Emmanuel Adeyemi-Abere October 24, 2026, 11:34 am GMT Follow VAVEL on Google Unai Emery looked ahead to the challenge of Aston Villa facing Manchester City .
 The Villans were victorious twice against City last campaign, beating them 1-0 at Villa Park in October and 2-1 at the Etihad Stadium in the final game of the Pep Guardiola era at the club.
 · ‘The difference is so, so, big, because they started fantastic’ 
 Even though his compatriot has now departed the dugout after a decade of service, Emery knows that City continue to be one of the standard bearers in the division. The Citizens have claimed seven straight Premier League victories at the start of the new season to sit three points clear of reigning champions Arsenal on a perfect tally of 21 points thanks to their individual quality in the attack.
 Enzo Maresca has also watched his men bounce back from the adversity of a 4-2 loss to PSG in Europe and the noise about the guilty verdict from the independent panel’s investigation into alleged financial misconduct. So, City are made of strong stuff, and they will be a tough test for Villa.
 “The are favourites (for the title), with Arsenal. The last year, Manchester City and Arsenal , they are so, so strong, so, so competitive in everything. Their identity is clear. We dream to be close to them. 
 “Three years ago, we were until December, competing with Arsenal and Manchester City . Last year, we were as well in December, competing close. Always, they were in front, but close. 
 “Now, they have 21 points, we have eight. The day seven. The difference is so, so, big, because they started fantastic, really fantastic, and they are performing, they are competing, they are winning. 
 “They only lost one match against Paris Saint-Germain in Champions League , so [Saturday] is a huge challenge. Huge. Always, it’s a huge challenge to play against Manchester City , always. 
 “In Villa Park , in Manchester, and as a coach, as a manager, I like so, so much to play matches against teams like Manchester City .”
